en.headline: Kowloon Tong preschool rejects father's claim of on-campus head injury to toddler
en.dek: Cannan Kindergarten said police reviewed CCTV footage and closed the case after finding no evidence the two-year-old was injured at the school.
body: Cannan Kindergarten on Waterloo Road has rejected a parent's allegation that his two-year-old son suffered a large bump on his head while on campus.

The school said police had reviewed CCTV footage and closed their investigation after finding no evidence that the child was injured at the premises. It added that it had not received any medical reports or professional opinions supporting the claim that the injuries occurred on site.

The kindergarten also said it could not accommodate the father's request to transfer the boy to another branch in Kowloon Tong because that branch was full. The Education Bureau had earlier ordered the school to submit a report after the parents complained about the unexplained injury.

zh.headline: 九龍塘幼稚園否認兩歲幼童校內受傷 警方查閱閉路電視後結案
zh.dek: 迦南幼稚園表示，警方檢視閉路電視後未發現幼童在校內受傷證據，已結束調查，校方亦未收到支持指控的醫療報告。
body: 窩打老道迦南幼稚園否認家長指其兩歲兒子在校內頭部受傷的指控。
校方表示，警方已檢視閉路電視片段，並因未發現幼童在校舍內受傷的證據而結束調查。校方又指，未收到任何醫療報告或專業意見支持傷勢發生在校園的說法。
幼稚園表示，因九龍塘另一分校已額滿，未能應家長要求將男童轉校。教育局較早時因家長投訴幼童放學後頭部出現大包，已要求校方提交報告。
